method.name: Method
method.description: Returns highlight method, Aspect_TOHM_COLOR by default.

method.name: SetMethod
method.description: Changes highlight method to the given one.

method.name: ColorRGBA
method.description: Returns basic presentation color (including alpha channel).

method.name: Color
method.description: Returns basic presentation color, Quantity_NOC_WHITE by default.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Sets basic presentation color (RGB components, does not modifies transparency).

method.name: Transparency
method.description: Returns basic presentation transparency (0 - opaque, 1 - fully transparent), 0 by default (opaque).

method.name: SetTransparency
method.description: Sets basic presentation transparency (0 - opaque, 1 - fully transparent).

method.name: ZLayer
method.description: Returns presentation Zlayer, Graphic3d_ZLayerId_Default by default. Graphic3d_ZLayerId_UNKNOWN means undefined (a layer of main presentation to be used).

method.name: DisplayMode
method.description: Returns display mode, 0 by default. -1 means undefined (main display mode of presentation to be used).

method.name: BasicFillAreaAspect
method.description: Return basic presentation fill area aspect, NULL by default. When set, might be used instead of Color() property.

method.name: SetBasicFillAreaAspect
method.description: Sets basic presentation fill area aspect.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
